name: unity
title: Unity — train her properly
description: Every knob the brain reads, each either PINNED to a value read off its own read site (the value her equations and the walk were derived against), or deliberately LEFT TO THE CODE because the code computes it (from RAM, VRAM, the link or her own measurements), it is a path / identity / secret, it is an opt-out whose correct state is the code's own, it is a diagnostic or emergency lever, or it is dead. Every row says which and why. Applied as one set; at most one restart.

rules.set: pinned — the value is copied from the code's fallback at the read site (never from the panel's displayed default, which was found wrong for three knobs) or deliberately changed, with the reason
rules.code: left unset on purpose — the category names the reason; pinning would freeze a computed value, change identity, or arm a lever that must stay off

DREAM_CONTENT_LR.why: Derived: Oja deposit 1-(1-lr)^n matched to ~25% per median word at 3 reps across the rebuilt corpus. The content lane carries her subject knowledge; this is the rate it was priced at.

DREAM_LATERAL_HINT.why: On unless '0'. The lateral pass reuses the motor index list the caller wrote; it self-verifies and disables itself on one mismatch.

DREAM_LATERAL_HINT_VERIFY.why: 500 checks of the hint against the full scan before trusting it. A safety budget, not a training magnitude.

DREAM_LEARN_GEOMETRY.why: On unless '0'. Geometry learning is part of the walk as built.

DREAM_PER_WORD_TEACH_TIMEOUT_MS.why: 120 s per word — fits the richest word's full definition teach and only fires when the dictionary fetch is dead. Not a learning budget.

DREAM_REHEARSAL_FRACTION.why: 2% of a cell's sentences re-present earlier grades of the same subject before new material — keeps old basins alive (spacing), priced against walk time.

DREAM_REHEARSAL_MAX.why: Ceiling on rehearsal sentences per cell so the richest cells cannot spend the fraction unbounded.

DREAM_REHEARSAL_REPS.why: One rep re-deposits ~4.7% onto an existing basin — a top-up, not a relearn. More reps re-price the walk linearly.

DREAM_REP_AUTOPRICE.why: Stays OFF. The sweep it indexes tops out at a collision load of 25 while the live load measured 1,542-7,471 — arming it would swap a stale constant for a confident reading off the wrong chart. Unarmed it still measures and publishes every gap.

DREAM_REP_AUTOPRICE_GAP_MS.why: Measure the collision load once a minute — it used to run on every call (25,603 in one boot).

DREAM_REP_COMPRESS.why: Kept at 40 knowingly STALE (measured on a corpus 11.2x smaller). Changing it changes what she is taught; the replacement is the AUTOPRICE measurement above, not a new guess.

DREAM_REP_COMPRESS_FLOOR.why: No compressed phase collapses below 4 presentations — a single exposure does not form a basin.

DREAM_REP_COMPRESS_LR_CEIL.why: Bounds the compensating rate raise when reps are compressed; above it Oja overshoots.

DREAM_REP_COMPRESS_MIN_DOSE.why: Minimum retained dose under compression (code fallback 6).

DREAM_SENTENCE_TRANSITION_REPS.why: Sentence-transition training floor — content sentences at 2 reps never formed word-order transitions.

DREAM_SM_LR_SCALE.why: Damps the sem->motor / sem->word_motor rate — the saturation-prevention lever that keeps emission rows from collapsing into one.

DREAM_STRUCTURE_DOSE.why: Full structure-pass dose. It was cut to 0.4 once and reverted: a dose multiplier is learning, not waste.

DREAM_TRICKLE_BATCH.why: The dream trickle sizes its own batch; no measured reason to fix it.

DREAM_VOCAB_RETEACH_MS.why: Re-teach window for exam vocabulary; the code's window is what stopped the re-teach runaway.

DREAM_ACAD_VOCAB_CAP.why: Diagnostic lever for bisecting a slow cell. Unlimited is the operating setting — a cap would leave words undefined.

DREAM_BATTERY_DEADLINE_MS.why: No battery-wide clock (code default since this template). The per-question cap is the hang guard; a battery clock only scored unreached questions 0 and failed gates on time, not on what she knew.

DREAM_BATTERY_GATE_HARD.why: Advisory: blockers are computed, logged and recorded, but do not hard-stop the walk. Completing the content is the bar.

DREAM_BATTERY_QUESTION_TIMEOUT_MS.why: Per-question hang guard — a probe that never returns degrades to 0 instead of wedging the walk.

DREAM_CELL_PASS_HARD.why: Unset: a cell's own pass verdict does not hard-stop the walk; the grade-major rounds bound re-teaching.

DREAM_CORPUS_BUFFER_BATCH.why: Corpus pull batch — small enough that scaffolding never grows, sized by the code.

DREAM_CORPUS_BUFFER_GAP_MS.why: Pacing of the background corpus pull so it never outruns the walk.

DREAM_DEF_EXAMPLE_CAP.why: Up to 10 dictionary example sentences per word bound into the definition lane.

DREAM_DEFERRED_DRAIN_MS.why: Drain the deferred lane (chat Hebbian, curiosity follow-up, percept grounding) every second.

DREAM_GATE_PATH_MIN.why: READ/THINK/TALK pathway score a gate requires — the K-gate standard every grade is held to.

DREAM_GATE_PROD_MIN.why: Production score a gate requires — she must SAY it, not just recognise it.

DREAM_GATE_READ.why: Unset = whole-prompt reading. 'initial' would measure only first letters — the exact defect this replaced.

DREAM_GATE_READINGS_MAX.why: How many cells' gate readings the dashboard keeps (24). Display only.

DREAM_GRADE_MAJOR_ROUNDS.why: 2 re-teach rounds per grade. This bound is what keeps a grade from wedging forever (Life once passed zero cells); changing it re-prices the walk.

DREAM_HELD_BACK.why: On: a failed cell gets the escalating re-teach ladder (mastery-gated remediation).

DREAM_K_UPFRONT_SEED.why: Off: an upfront bulk Hebbian blurs basins before meanings exist.

DREAM_LONG_PHASE_NOTE_MS.why: When a long phase prints a progress note. Log cadence only.

DREAM_MAX_GRADE.why: Unset = the full K-to-PhD walk. A ceiling would stop her early.

DREAM_MECH_EVERY_CELL.why: The foundation always runs; the every-cell re-run stays the code's choice.

DREAM_PRECELL_VOCAB.why: On: meanings are taught before bindings, or Hebbian lands on noise.

DREAM_PROBE_DEADLINE_MS.why: Bounds a probe that can hang; falling through costs speed, never a learned weight.

DREAM_SELF_FRAME.why: On: first-person reframing at the vocab/sentence chokepoints.

DREAM_SELF_FRAME_LIGHT_MAX_UNITS.why: Cap for the light reframe, the code's own.

DREAM_SELF_FRAME_MAX_UNITS.why: Cap for the full reframe, the code's own.

DREAM_TEACH_BUNDLE.why: On for 0.3.43+ donors: teach frames ride one bundle message.

DREAM_TEACH_FAST.why: On: the card-held lesson path — the whole lesson runs on the GPU.

DREAM_TRICKLE_WORD_MS.why: 60 s per dream word; the word stays in the queue for a later window. Defers, does not drop.

DREAM_WALK_TICK_MS.why: Walk heartbeat interval, derived by the server.

DREAM_CHAT_COHERENCE_FLOOR.why: Chat-only refusal floor; the code's value (0.10) is the one the chat path was tuned with.

DREAM_CHAT_MAX_WORDS.why: Code fallback is 12 (the panel showed 10). Bounds a diffuse-sem run-on; her strongest words lead, so the clamp keeps the signal.

DREAM_CHAT_QPROBE_TIMEOUT_MS.why: Input-scaled (45 s + 1 s per word past 8, cap 90 s). A constant would be wrong for both short and long messages.

DREAM_IMAGE_CHAT_YIELD_MS.why: How long a chat render waits on an in-flight donor upload (15 s).

DREAM_INNERVOICE_FORCE_CPU.why: Unset: her inner voice runs on the GPU path.

DREAM_INNERVOICE_GPU_GEN.why: On since it was found dormant — her inner voice is generated.

DREAM_INNERVOICE_MAX_NEURONS.why: Above 2M the CPU inner-voice path no-ops instead of pinning the loop; the GPU path carries it.

DREAM_INQUIRE_DEPTH.why: Curiosity follow-up depth — three questions deep before she stops asking.

DREAM_LANG_CORTEX.why: ⛔ NEVER PIN. The language cortex is sized at boot from free RAM and pinned to her geometry file; the panel's 100,000 is a stale comment — pinning it would shrink her and force a fresh walk.

DREAM_LANG_RAM_FRACTION.why: Derived RAM share for the language cortex.

DREAM_LANG_UNPIN.why: Re-derive and repin her geometry — a deliberate one-off act, never a standing setting.

DREAM_SPEAKLOOP.why: On: the speak loop drills what she fails to say.

DREAM_SPEAKLOOP_DRILL_MAX_MS.why: Speak-loop drill budget, the code's own; bounded so the drill cannot eat the walk.

DREAM_SPEAKLOOP_MAX_FAILS.why: Fail cap before a pair stops being drilled this visit.

DREAM_THOUGHT_CONCEPT_GAP_MS.why: 10-min per-concept cooldown on trained-read thoughts so one concept cannot own her inner voice.

DREAM_WORD_MOTOR_VOCAB_CAP.why: ⛔ Code fallback is 50,000 words (the panel showed 10 — pinning that would have silenced all but 10 words). One bucket per word on the unified word_motor band.

DREAM_CONSOLIDATE_WHILE_UNPOWERED.why: No consolidation with no GPU attached — it would pin the CPU.

DREAM_CONSOLIDATION_DISABLE.why: Consolidation stays ON: it moves Tier 1 episodes to Tier 2 schemas and keeps the walk finite.

DREAM_CONSOLIDATION_FORCE_MAX_MS.why: 120 s forced-pass cap (re-priced so Tier-3 promotion finishes). RE-PRICE LAW: not changed without the walk price.

DREAM_CONSOLIDATION_FORCE_MS.why: Starvation-guard cadence (forced pass after ~2 h without one).

DREAM_CONSOLIDATION_MAX_MS.why: The routine consolidation cap — the gate the RE-PRICE LAW names as keeping the walk finite (~24 d vs ~100 d).

DREAM_CONSOLIDATION_WATCHDOG_MS.why: 300 s watchdog on a consolidation pass that never returns.

DREAM_DEFINITION_CACHE_FILE.why: Persistent definition cache at server/definition-cache.json — a path, not a magnitude.

DREAM_ART_RELEARN_GAP_MS.why: Per-concept relearn pacing after a reject (10 min) so reject-spam cannot burn looks.

DREAM_CHAT_IMAGE_PRIORITY_MS.why: 45 s chat-image priority window over background looks.

DREAM_DRAW_STYLE.why: 'own' — she draws in her own hand. Not changed.

DREAM_EYE_PROCESS.why: On: the mind's eye shows the drawing come together.

DREAM_EYE_SHOW_THOUGHT.why: Off: the thought word is not stamped on her mind's-eye frame.

DREAM_EYE_TRANSITION_MS.why: On: frames melt into each other instead of cutting.

DREAM_IMAGE_UNLOAD_IDLE_MS.why: Unload the renderer after 20 s idle to give VRAM back (reload measured 0.6 s).

DREAM_JPEG_MAX_MB.why: 2 GB decode cap (512 MB refused the corpus's largest figures).

DREAM_LOOKUP_HOLD_MS.why: She looks at a reference 4.5 s before drawing it.

DREAM_OWNART_INGEST_WALK_MS.why: Own-art ingest cadence during the walk.

DREAM_OWNART_MAX_SUBJECTS.why: Up to 3 subjects in one drawing.

DREAM_PERCEPT_GROUND_MAX_QUEUE.why: Percept-grounding queue bound (16); overflow is counted, not hidden.

DREAM_POLLINATIONS_KEY.why: Pollinations was removed from the brain entirely. No key, ever.

DREAM_PRACTICE_GAP_MS.why: 30 min between drawing-practice sessions on one concept.

DREAM_REF_FETCH_GAP_MS.why: Look gap on her own card (30 s) — a look spends her own VRAM.

DREAM_REF_MIN_DETAIL.why: Minimum detail a reference needs to be learned from (200).

DREAM_SPONTANEOUS_IMG_AROUSAL.why: Arousal above 0.7 makes her draw on her own.

DREAM_VM_CAP.why: 25,000-percept visual-memory count guard (bytes are the real bound).

DREAM_VM_RECALL_COOLDOWN_MS.why: One percept cannot own the mind's eye.

DREAM_WRITE_PRACTICE_GAP_MS.why: 30 min between writing-practice sessions on one text.

DREAM_BC_COMPOUND_COH_MIN.why: Compound-emission coherence floor, the code's own.

DREAM_BC_EMISSION_DOM_MAX.why: One word may take at most 45% of emissions before it reads as domination — the collapse detector for sem->motor.

DREAM_BC_RECTIFY_DECAY.why: Multiplicative decay applied to a COLLAPSED emission matrix (capped 0.95) — what stops saturation hard-stopping the walk.

DREAM_BC_RECTIFY_NORM.why: Row-normalisation target after rectification, paired with the decay above.

DREAM_BC_VOCAB_MIN.why: Vocabulary-coherence floor for the basin check.

DREAM_BCM.why: Off: BCM was a finished experiment; Oja is the measured rule.

DREAM_FIRING_TARGET_PCT.why: Homeostatic set point. ⚠ Her live firing is BISTABLE (busy above drive ~0.4, near-silent below ~0.06); at 7.5% the controller's swing averages on target. Giving her a stable middle is a dynamics change that is the operator's call — not a number this template moves.

DREAM_GEN_PROPAGATE_CHUNKED.why: On: chunked propagate on generation so speaking never pins the loop.

DREAM_HUBS.why: On: rich-club hubs (5% of L2/3 + L5). Geometry — changing it forces a fresh walk.

DREAM_LAMINATION_VETO.why: Off: the layer mask is a bias, not a veto (the veto left layers dead).

DREAM_NOISE_GATE.why: On: the noise gate. An opt-out a past audit misread as disabled.

DREAM_PSI_GAIN_SCALE.why: ⛔ Not 2.0: unset, the scale is DERIVED from Ψ's own measured deviation spread (σ / atanh 0.5). Pinning would freeze an adaptive term.

DREAM_REL_USE_FLAT_TTL_MS.why: 30 min reuse of a flat relation read.

DREAM_REL_USE_TTL_MS.why: 30 s reuse of a confident relation read.

DREAM_SAT_MEANABS.why: Saturation check: mean |w| above 0.6 x wMax reads as concentrated (ANDed with the ratio).

DREAM_SAT_MEANCOS.why: Saturation check: sem->motor rows more alike than cos 0.7 = 'everything means everything'.

DREAM_SAT_RATIO.why: Saturation check: peak/mean below 1.5 reads as flattened.

DREAM_SEM_TOPOGRAPHIC.why: Off: the sem projections are not on the topographic prior (it clustered meanings by index, not by meaning).

DREAM_SM_WMAX.why: Weight ceiling on sem->motor and sem->word_motor — the saturation bound the check above measures against.

DREAM_SMALL_WORLD.why: On for size >= 2K: Watts-Strogatz connectivity. Geometry.

DREAM_THETA_GAMMA.why: On: 6 Hz theta / 40 Hz gamma learning-rate modulation.

DREAM_TOPO_RADIUS_FRAC.why: Used only when sem is topographic (it is not).

DREAM_BATCH_STALL_MS.why: When a compute batch counts as stalled.

DREAM_DELTA_COLIDX.why: DISABLED until its corruption is reproduced offline. Must stay off.

DREAM_DF7_BACKED_PENALTY.why: Work-routing penalty for a backed-up donor.

DREAM_DF7_FANOUT.why: On: work spreads across the pool.

DREAM_DF7_FANOUT_PROPAGATE.why: Off: read fan-out stays off until proven.

DREAM_DF7_INFLIGHT.why: Work units in flight per donor (2).

DREAM_DF7_MIN_BIND_MB.why: Smallest bind a card must hold (1.8 GB).

DREAM_DF7_MIN_VRAM_MB.why: Smallest card the pool uses (1.5 GB).

DREAM_DF7_REBALANCE.why: OFF: the partition decides cortex placement; the strength rebalance lost learning three ways.

DREAM_DF7_REBALANCE_MS.why: Only matters if the rebalance is on (it is not).

DREAM_DF7_REBROADCAST_DUTY.why: Rebroadcast duty bound (an unbounded one starved the curriculum).

DREAM_DF7_REGISTRY_WAIT_MS.why: Bounded wait on the replica registry.

DREAM_DF7_REPLICA_SYNC.why: OFF: no full-brain push to cards that do not own the cortex — it was 6 GB per join for nothing.

DREAM_DF7_WORK_FLOOR.why: Work floor so a willing high-RTT card still gets units.

DREAM_DONOR_CHECKPOINT_MS.why: Donor-side weight checkpoint every 10 min — what saved a dropped pod's learning.

DREAM_GATE_GPU_PROBES.why: On: gate probes run on the GPU.

DREAM_HB_BUF_FORGIVE_MB.why: Heartbeat forgiveness for a socket with a real backlog.

DREAM_IMAGE_MIN_FREE_VRAM_MB.why: Renderer free-VRAM floor (3 GB) so a look cannot starve the donor's CUDA context.

DREAM_MIN_DONOR_VERSION.why: 0.3.26 floor: older donors still work (unpaced lessons fall back per pair). Raising it would turn helpers away.

DREAM_NO_AUTO_GPU.why: Unset: the launcher brings a GPU up automatically.

DREAM_NO_DONOR_ID_EVICT.why: Unset: stale sockets sharing a donor id are reaped.

DREAM_RANGE_MAX_RUNS.why: The donor's own acceptance limit (16) — not a tuning dial.

DREAM_READBACK_MIN_GAP_MS.why: 30 min local weight pull; a remote cortex holder uses the 10 min gap.

DREAM_RECOMMENDED_DONOR_VERSION.why: Read from donor-app/Cargo.toml at boot, so it follows every release by itself. A pin here (first cut: 0.3.46) goes stale at the next release.

DREAM_RESPECT_VRAM_CAP.why: Donor VRAM cap policy, the code's.

DREAM_SPARSE_CHUNK_NNZ.why: 750k nnz chunks — under the donor's frame ceiling.

DREAM_SPARSE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS.why: Upload timeout, size-scaled and re-armed on progress.

DREAM_UPLOAD_GRACE_MIN.why: Upload grace before the walk calls it stalled.

DREAM_UPLOAD_MIN_MBPS.why: Assumed floor rate for upload deadlines.

DREAM_UPLOAD_WAIT_DONOR_MS.why: Bounded wait for a donor before an upload.

DREAM_WS_SOFT_SHED_MB.why: Soft-shed threshold for fire-and-forget shadow frames.

DREAM_FORCE_CLEAR.why: Never a standing setting — it wipes her.

DREAM_KEEP_STATE.why: ⛔ Owned by the launcher: start.bat wipes, Savestart.bat keeps. A template must never decide whether she is wiped.

DREAM_SAVE_MIN_FREE_DISK_MB.why: Disk floor for a save (defer, never drop).

DREAM_STATE_SEND_CAP_MB.why: 4 MB viewer backlog cap (viewers held 1.1 GB before it).

DREAM_WEIGHTS_PAIR_TOL_SEC.why: Checkpoint pair coherence tolerance, derived from observed pairs.

DREAM_BRAIN_BUDGET_MB.why: ⛔ Her neuron count is DERIVED at boot from free RAM. Pinning a budget pins her size.

DREAM_CPU_PROFILE.why: On: the self-profile that names what fills the main thread.

DREAM_CSR_FREE_MIN_MB.why: Only free CPU arrays when it pays.

DREAM_DEF_CONTENT_CAP.why: Up to 24 content words per definition bound into her meaning of a word.

DREAM_DEF_SYNONYM_CAP.why: Up to 6 synonyms per word — the weakest signal of the three, so capped lowest.

DREAM_HEAP_REEXECED.why: Set by the process itself when it re-execs with a bigger heap.

DREAM_NO_HEAP_REEXEC.why: Unset: she re-execs with the heap she needs.

DREAM_NO_PRIMARY_WATCHDOG_MS.why: Bounded wait with no cortex owner.

DREAM_PHASE_BUDGET_MS.why: 0 = no per-phase budget. A phase takes what it takes.

DREAM_TEXTFIG_PER_CELL.why: 6 textbook figures perceived per cell visit.

DREAM_TUNNEL_MAX_RTT_MS.why: Derived: 1,250 ms gamma cycle / 64 round trips = 19 ms. A remote cortex owner cannot carry the tunnel through separate frames; the in-batch form is the follow-up.

DREAM_UPLOAD_STALL_MS.why: When an upload counts as stalled.

DREAM_VM_RELATE_REPS.why: 4 reps when relating a new percept.

DREAM_WEDGE_WARN_MS.why: When an alive-but-not-teaching cell prints its diagnostic.

DREAM_WINDOW_MAX_MS.why: Dream-window budget (180 s): an over-budget stage is DEFERRED to the next window, never dropped.

DREAM_GLOVE_FETCH.why: On: GloVe is provisioned if missing.

DREAM_IMAGINE_POOL_KEEP.why: 24 learned shapes kept moving in her imagination.

DREAM_LESSON_INFLIGHT.why: ⭐ Adaptive since this template: lessons in flight = ceil(ack-latency floor / card time per lesson) + 2, clamped 4-64 — sized to the link so a rented card stays busy and the queue stays bounded. Pinning brings back the fixed window that left a remote card ~85% idle.

DREAM_POOL_CORTEX_HOLD_S.why: 300 s hold-down — only for a card that DROPPED and came back.

DREAM_POOL_CORTEX_MOVE_COOLDOWN_S.why: 30 min between cortex moves (each is a full re-upload).

DREAM_POOL_CORTEX_MOVE_RATIO.why: The cortex moves to a card with >= 1.5x the room.

DREAM_READBACK_IDLE_MS.why: Derived from the measured wire rate.

DREAM_READBACK_REMOTE_GAP_MS.why: 10 min weight pull while a remote card holds the cortex.

DREAM_RNG_SEED.why: ⛔ Her seed is HER — restored from her weights or drawn fresh on a wipe. Never pinned by a template.

DREAM_WEIGHT_FIT_PCT.why: Weights fit under 85% of memory.high so she cannot pin at the ceiling.

DREAM_WEIGHT_PRUNE.why: On: drops the smallest weights only as far as needed to fit.
